suggestions.assertion: A walking-skeleton slice is explicitly marked and is a strict subset of all stories
suggestions.reason: This passes as written, but the run itself flagged (unprompted) that it left the entire 'Manage tags' journey (rename/delete/merge) out of the skeleton -- zero representation for one of four journeys. The skill's own definition says the skeleton should be 'the thinnest path through every journey', but no assertion actually checks per-journey coverage, only that the slice is a strict subset. Worth adding a 'every journey has at least one sliced story' assertion next iteration -- this run's self-flagging is good (better than iteration-1, where this kind of gap went unflagged entirely), but the eval should catch it mechanically too.

eval_feedback.overall: Full pass on the written assertions, but exposes a real gap in the assertions themselves: journey-coverage isn't checked, only subset-ness. The model is now honest about this gap in its own transcript, which is a meaningful improvement in transparency even though the underlying skeleton choice is debatable.

uncertainties: Left 'Manage tags' (rename/delete/merge) entirely out of the slice -- flagged as a deviation from 'thin path through every journey' in the transcript.
needs_review: Whether 'Manage tags' having zero skeleton coverage is acceptable, or whether at least one of rename/delete/merge should have been pulled into the slice.
